name: datawizard-skills
description: Thematic skill plugins for the OS Datawizard system — session management, content tools, client delivery, product design, business advice, talent coaching, and wiki tools.

plugins.name: datawizard-core
plugins.description: Markdown vault session workflow (start, wrap, ship) and global rules for the OS Datawizard system.

plugins.name: content-tools
plugins.description: Document conversion and processing tools — email-to-markdown, pdf-to-markdown, process-meeting-transcript, generate-images.

plugins.name: client-delivery
plugins.description: Client work tools — discovery process, advisory personas, project scaffolding.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: Complete product design and prototyping pipeline — Design Thinking process, wireframing, HTML prototyping, branding, backlog building, business cases, and UI/UX intelligence.

plugins.name: business-advice
plugins.description: Business consultant personas — Hormozi direct-advice style and Inizio (Czech entrepreneur) style.

plugins.name: talent-coaching
plugins.description: Kasimaka talent coaching personas — coaching, decision-making, reflection, project review, sales preparation.

plugins.name: wiki-tools
plugins.description: Markdown wiki tools — ingest new content, lint quality, query knowledge base.

plugins.name: web-conversion
plugins.description: Plan and execute web project conversions from prototypes (Lovable, etc.) into production-ready stacks, or scaffold new projects from architectural templates.

plugins.name: web-motion
plugins.description: Animated and interactive web patterns — animated demo windows (terminal typewriter, IDE, blueprint pipeline, CRT boot) and hook-switcher for live hero copy comparison on prototypes.

plugins.name: writing-style
plugins.description: Write in Karel's voice across channels (LinkedIn, e-mail, messages, offers) and check any Czech text for AI signatures (dashes, fragments, forbidden phrases).
